verdict.rationale: Kit's docs confirm an email editor with a saved brand color palette (up to 10 hex codes), broadcasts that carry an assigned email template, and custom-field keys used as personalization tags in sequences and broadcasts. Collaborative editing is also listed. That covers the on-brand, template and token elements, but only through thin API-reference mentions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual/drag-and-drop editor, detail on creating and reusing templates, evidence that personalization renders correctly across email clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
